text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at a large gain felt rewarding, but the gain alone does not show whether selling was the right choice; I should decide based on its future risk and my portfolio plan.","My account can change substantially even when I make no trades, so I should review overall risk and diversification rather than focus only on individual winners.","Because past price moves do not predict future moves, I should avoid reacting to recent performance and trade only when my goals or portfolio balance justify it."]}
